import hashlib, json, re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/services/boamp-inventory-reconciliation')
raw = (root / 'raw/boamp-inventory.json').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == 'a2c1adaf58efec51b40110268a49d3f4a81a8b301779487975ac75e7bed5edd5'
source = json.loads(raw)
assert isinstance(source.get('results'), list)
now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
asset = re.compile(r'\b(?:immobilisations?|registre des actifs|inventaire (?:physique|comptable|patrimonial)|rapprochement (?:comptable|d.inventaire)|fiabilisation (?:de l.inventaire|des données)|inventaire du mobilier)\b', re.I)
exclusion = re.compile(r'\b(?:tourbières|faune|flore|habitats|hydrobiologiques)\b', re.I)
records = []
for item in source['results']:
    title = item.get('objet') or ''
    deadline = item.get('datelimitereponse')
    live = None
    if deadline:
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(deadline.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
            if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
                live = parsed > now
        except ValueError:
            pass
    payload = item.get('donnees') or ''
    text = payload if isinstance(payload, str) else json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)
    matches = sorted({match.group(0).lower() for match in asset.finditer(title + '\n' + text)})
    records.append({'notice_id': item.get('idweb'), 'buyer': item.get('nomacheteur'), 'title': title, 'notice_type': item.get('nature'), 'published': item.get('dateparution'), 'structured_deadline': deadline, 'structured_deadline_in_future': live, 'asset_terms_found': matches, 'ecology_terms_in_title': bool(exclusion.search(title))})
result = {'checked_at': now.isoformat(), 'capture_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'source_reported_total': source.get('total_count'), 'records_checked': len(records), 'records': records, 'scope': 'Single captured page. Keyword hits and structured dates are pointers. Verify the original notice for current status, scope and separately quotable acceptance criteria before drafting a quote.'}
output = root / 'capture-scope-screen.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'records_checked': len(records), 'asset_term_notice_ids': [row['notice_id'] for row in records if row['asset_terms_found'] and not row['ecology_terms_in_title']]}))
